query: UPDATE bookings b SET status = 'completed', completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() FROM open_tickets ot WHERE ot.id = $1 AND ot.booking_id = b.id AND b.status = 'seated' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM open_tickets o2 WHERE o2.booking_id = b.id AND o2.id <> ot.id AND o2.status = 'open') RETURNING b.id
